declarations.name: defineElement
declarations.description:
Register a custom element once; a no-op if the tag is already defined
(prevents "already defined" crashes on double-load / HMR).

Shared base for all `<tc-*>` components.
`delegatesFocus` forwards external `.focus()` and label clicks to the inner
native control inside the shadow root.

members.description: 目前頁碼兩側固定顯示的頁數，預設 1。

members.description: 導覽區域的無障礙標籤，套用至 <nav> 的 aria-label。

members.name: #total
members.description: Clamp `total` to at least 1 and `page` into `[1, total]`.

members.name: #range
members.description:
Compute the windowed list of page numbers, inserting ELLIPSIS sentinels.
Always shows the first and last page; shows `siblingCount` pages on each
side of the current page. Collapses gaps wider than one page into an
ellipsis, but keeps a real page number when the gap is exactly one.
